ai_review.summary: Decent audience recording of a Shakedown encore, praised for its clear capture despite being a first‑click bootleg.
ai_review.review: The sole reviewer gives the tape five stars, calling it a “quite decent audience recording” and expressing excitement about being the first to discover it. While no specific musical details are offered, the mention of a Shakedown encore suggests the performance is at least memorable enough to note. Overall the recording is considered listenable and enjoyable for fans seeking rare bootleg material.
